gap: No result ChatGPT got states that VIOFO's A229 Pro gets its buffered parking mode only through the Type-C HK4 kit (not the mini-USB HK3, and not the HK6 that VIOFO's Amazon listing names for the A329S and A119M Pro), or that the cheaper $17.99 HK4 comes without fuse taps while the $25.99 HK4 includes 8.
standout_why: Dashlore (cited) does name hardwire kits by model, so part of this is already out there. It says the A229 Ultra, A229 Ultra 3CH, A329S and A119M Pro 'need the HK4 or HK6'. It gives no connector type, no excluded kits and no cutoff voltages, and it doesn't say whether fuse taps come in the box. Its only power wording is that a kit 'taps your fuse box'. ChatGPT's own answer just says 'optional hardwire kit' and doesn't name the kit. Technobezz (cited) returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-14, so I couldn't check it. The fuse-tap difference is new and changes what goes in the cart, because without a fuse tap the shopper can't finish the install with what they bought. The HK3/HK6 exclusions are only partly in Dashlore. VIOFO's own sources disagree on whether the HK6 fits the A229 line, which is one more reason to put the HK4 in the cart.
kit_items: Dash cam: VIOFO A229 Pro (ChatGPT's 'my pick'). VIOFO says parking modes need the HK4 sold separately ('With the HK4 hardwire kit (sold separately), the A229 Pro offers buffered Auto Event Detection (saves 15 seconds before impact)').

Hardwire kit: VIOFO HK4 Type-C with the 8-piece fuse tap set (Amazon B0CHDXPGP1). VIOFO lists the HK4 for the A229 Pro, Plus and Ultra. The HK3 is for mini-port A119 V3 and A129 models. The $17.99 HK4 (B09MRVP2PX) says 'Fuse Tap Not Included'.
Other store: DDPAI N5 Pro plus DDPAI's 'Hardwire Kit with Fuse Tap For All DDPAI Dash Cams (Excluding Z100 Master)'. DDPAI's cheaper Type-C IPS kit is listed only for the MINI5, Z40 and mola N3 Pro.
microSD card: no card added. I couldn't source the A229 Pro's maximum card size or VIOFO's recommended card (see unsourced).

findings.label: Hybrid Parking needs the HK6
findings.value: 'Hybrid Parking Mode... requires the HK6 — the older HK4 does not support voltage-based switching.' The kit takes constant 12–24 V from the fuse box.
findings.source_title: VIOFO Type-C HK6 ACC Hardwire Kit for A329S/A229/A119M Pro Series
findings.note: storecheck search of VIOFO's store, $25.99. The store title includes 'A229' but the text describes A329S features only. That conflicts with the Amazon title above and with BSTA, which lists A229 as not compatible with the HK6. So the HK6 shouldn't go in an A229 Pro kit.

findings.label: BSTA's compatibility table
findings.value: HK6: A329S, A329T and A329W only, with A229 listed under 'Not Compatible With'. HK4: 'Adjustable low-voltage protection (11.8V / 12.0V / 12.2V)'
findings.note: This is a retailer's comparison, not VIOFO's document. It gives no 24 V values.

findings.label: Which kit fits which camera
findings.value: 'Hardwire Kit with Fuse Tap For All DDPAI Dash Cams (Excluding Z100 Master)' $29.99. 'Type-C IPS hardwire kit is suitable for MINI5, Z40 and mola N3 Pro dash cam' $15.99. The X2S Pro has its hardwire module built into the power cable.
findings.source_title: Hardwire Kit with Fuse Tap For All DDPAI Dash Cams (Excluding Z100 Master)
findings.note: storecheck search of DDPAI's store. The IPS kit wording is from https://store.ddpai.com/products/type-c-ips-hardwire-kit. N5 Pro is $259 at https://store.ddpai.com/products/n5-pro-dash-cam.

findings.label: What Dashlore says about kits
findings.value: 'VIOFO lists the HK4, HK6 or HK6-F depending on the model'. The A229 Ultra 3CH, A329S 3CH, A229 Ultra 2CH and A119M Pro 'need the HK4 or HK6'. No connector, cutoff voltage or fuse-tap details.
findings.source_title: Best Dash Cam with Parking Mode: Buffered Picks Ranked | Dashlore
